caseNameFull: Lamont, doing business as Basic Pamphlets v. Postmaster General
attorneys: Leonard B. Boudin, Victor Rabino-witz and Henry Winestine for appellant. Solicitor General Cox, Assistant Attorney General Yeagley, Kevin T. Maroney and Lee B. Anderson for appellee.

opinions.text:
Appeal from the United States District Court for the Southern District of New York. Probable jurisdiction noted. Counsel are directed to discuss in their briefs and oral argument the question of mootness as well as the merits of the case.

Mr. Justice White took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
